headlines.headline: COLORADO AND TENNESSEE JUDGES GRANT A FIFTH SEASON OF ELIGIBILITY TO 30 MORE BASKETBALL PLAYERS, GUTTING THE NCAA'S 'FIVE-FOR-FIVE' RULE
headlines.detail: Judge Charlotte Sweeney in Colorado and a Tennessee counterpart granted preliminary injunctions giving 30 class-of-2022 players, including former Michigan State duo Jaxon Kohler and Tre Holloman, a fifth season after finding the NCAA applied its age-based rules inconsistently; NCAA president Charlie Baker renewed his push for Congress to pass the Save College Sports Act.

headlines.headline: LEBRON JAMES SIGNS A TWO-YEAR, $8 MILLION DEAL WITH THE 76ERS, CALLING IT HIS 'LAST DECISION'
headlines.detail: LeBron James joined Philadelphia on a two-year, $8 million deal, teaming with Joel Embiid and fellow Finals MVP addition Jaylen Brown after saying he strongly considered retirement, capping an offseason that also sent Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami, Kawhi Leonard to Toronto and Ja Morant to Portland.

headlines.headline: EAGLES MAKE JALEN CARTER THE NFL'S HIGHEST-PAID DEFENSIVE TACKLE WITH A FOUR-YEAR, $152 MILLION EXTENSION
headlines.detail: Philadelphia signed Jalen Carter to a four-year extension worth up to $160 million with escalators and $106 million guaranteed, built around option bonuses and void years, as all 32 teams kicked off Training Camp: Back Together Weekend.

headlines.headline: ESPN'S PRESEASON TOP 25 PUTS OHIO STATE AT NO. 1, WITH ARCH MANNING'S TEXAS AND HEISMAN HOPES ON THE RISE
headlines.detail: ESPN's preseason poll opens with Ohio State, Texas, Notre Dame, Georgia and Alabama atop the top five, while reigning 16-0 national champion Indiana slots lower as the Big Ten and SEC dominate; Texas QB Arch Manning enters as a preseason Heisman favorite ahead of the AP poll's Aug. 17 release.
